artifacts.title: Multisite church polity and scope of session and presbytery oversight

matches.evidence: The CCB advised that BCO 4 neither prescribes nor proscribes multisite polity, and that presbytery retains review and control over all worship sites, including new ones.

artifacts.title: Teaching Elders serving as corporate officers or trustees of a particular church

matches.evidence: The CCB advised that it is unconstitutional for Teaching Elders to serve as officers or trustees of the corporation of a particular church under BCO 4.
